name: hxunity-yaml
description: Read and write Unity 2022.3 YAML assets (.prefab, .asset, .unity, .mat, .controller, .meta) with format-preserving round trips and a GameObject/Transform/Component object graph.
releasenote: YAML 1.1 document layer, Unity object graph, and a writer that keeps line endings, field order and quoting as Unity wrote them.
